svg.title: How CSF fits together: two loops
svg.desc: A big loop around CPU 0 builds the robot's autonomy, clockwise: declare with the languages and csfc, run on the runtime library, show with gotth-live, change with the agent harness, ship with deploy and Warden, and learn with xetcas, which is planned. Beside the agent harness sits a small loop, Ouroboros, which takes every session trace and returns the next gate. A panel opens the small loop: the corpus of runs, extract.ml facts with source lines, a rules.dl Datalog rule, a walk-forward backtest that fits a knee of 468 seconds on earlier runs and judges later ones with one true positive, no false positives, no misses and a 304 second lead, and the gate that closes the ticket. The gated runs become the next corpus. Planned: log_mistake types each rule with csfc and proves it in Lean before it can gate.
svg.text: Two loops: a big one builds the robot's autonomy, a small one beside it mines our mistakes into gates
Big loop: start at 1 · declare (upper left) and read clockwise. Small loop: Ouroboros, opened up in the panel below.
a web page anyone can use;
Inside the small loop: one turn of Ouroboros
The DRAFT-PR-LATE miner on three real runs. The five stages are plain code; LLMs enter only at the two rose inputs.
LLM: an agent writes extract.ml + rules.dl
LLM: csf label proposes, you judge
the gated runs become the next corpus: the snake eats its tail
planned: log_mistake types each rule with csfc and proves it sound in Lean before it can gate
